description: Texture of USER-SPECIFIED ORNAMENTS hung on a composed line: where texture decorated throws random-shaped bursts at its line, ORNATE plays exact little melodies you write. The notedata file carries line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of the input sound, then TWO OR MORE '#N' note blocks (rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur'): block 1 = the line to ornament (restated every skiptime), blocks 2+ = the ornament shape(s) - with several ornament blocks the engine picks among them. Source-pinned placement (texture4.c:1032-37): plain ornate RANDOMLY PERMUTES whether each ornament falls before or after its line note; the preornate/postornate siblings force before/after (all three verified DISTINCT at the same seed - separate curated entries). Fewer than two blocks refuses 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' (verbatim; extra blocks legal - a 3-block file rendered). Pinned to submode 5 (NONE - no harmonic field; modes 1-4 lock pitches to hfield/hset blocks and add a block to the expected count). multlo/multhi (CDP-enforced 0.01-100, verbatim) scale each ornament statement's total duration relative to the ornamented note. Genuinely stochastic with a WORKING -r seed (-r5 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical; -r9 differs; unseeded runs differ). Duration honesty: outdur 5 -> 6.14 (+23%), outdur 8 -> 8.79 (+9.9%) - overshoot is roughly the line span plus the last ornament's tail. Breakpoints: every numeric positional accepted a brk file EXCEPT outdur, gpspace and contour (refusals verbatim 'Cannot read parameter 1/14/17'); flags -a/-p/-s brk-capable, seed refused (parameter 30); skiptime brk VERIFIED against both scalar endpoints at seed 5. Unlike texture decorated, skiptime 0 did NOT hang here (exit 0, valid render) - but keep it positive, the decorated hang was content-dependent. Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO. Flags are ORDER-ENFORCED ('option flag -a out of order on cmdline.').
musical_use: Composed embellishment at texture density: write a mordent, a turn, a five-note flourish as a '#N' block and the engine grafts it onto every note of your line, transposed to the line pitch, restated every skiptime - baroque ornamentation, gamelan-style kotekan flickers, or grace-note halos, all from one sample. Because ornament SHAPES are exact (contrast decorated's dice-rolled clusters), motives stay recognisable across restatements while placement (before/after each note) is permuted for life - force it with preornate/postornate when you need consistency. multlo/multhi are the phrase-time knobs: below 1 compresses ornaments into snaps, above 1 relaxes them into slow arabesques, and a multlo->multhi spread randomises pacing per statement. Give the line long dur values and the ornaments short ones for figure-and-ground; -k does not exist here (that is decorated) but -w rings every event to the source's end for overlapping halos. Multiple ornament blocks = a small vocabulary the texture rotates through. Always set a seed to pin a take.

notedata.description: REQUIRED text file (write_data_file()): line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of each input sound (single value here); then '#N' + N rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur' for the LINE to ornament; then one or more further '#N' blocks = ornament shapes (times within a block ascending from 0; amp MIDI-style 1-127; dur seconds). Under two blocks: 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

outdur.description: Requested (minimum) duration. Actual overshoots by about the line span plus the final ornament tail: +23% at outdur 5, +9.9% at outdur 8 on the 0.5 s-ping probe - keep line+ornament small relative to outdur when length matters. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1').

skiptime.description: Time between restatements of the ornamented line (family range 0.000002-100). Breakpoint-capable and VERIFIED: a 0.8->2.0 brk at seed 5 differs from both scalar-endpoint renders. skiptime 0 exited 0 with a valid render on this mode's probe, but the decorated-family hang is content-dependent - keep it positive.

sndfirst.description: First sound to use from the input list (single-input entry: must be 1). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

sndlast.description: Last sound to use from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

mingain.description: Minimum event level 1-127 (family standard). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

mindur.description: Minimum event duration (family floor 0.016). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

maxdur.description: Maximum event duration (>= mindur; values far beyond the input duration fail obscurely - family finding). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

phgrid.description: Timegrid in ms applying WITHIN ornaments (0 = none). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

gpspace.description: Spatialisation of ornament-groups, CDP-enforced 0-5 ('Parameter[11] Value (6.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 5.000000)'): 0 still, 1 scattered (default), 2 towards centre, 3 away, 4/5 follow/counter motion. Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 14') - family manual divergence.

gpsprange.description: Spatial range of ornament-groups 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

amprise.description: Amplitude change within each ornament, 0-127 (default 0 = flat). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

contour.description: Amplitude contour of ornaments, CDP-enforced 0-8 ('Parameter[14] Value (9.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 8.000000)'): 0 mixed, 1 cresc, 2 flat, 3 decresc, 4-6 combinations, 7/8 directed-to-event extras (ornate/decorated family). Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 17').

multlo.description: Minimum multiplier of each ornament statement's total duration (CDP-enforced 0.01-100: 'Parameter[15] Value (0.000000) out of range (0.010000 to 100.000000)'). Below 1 compresses the written shape in time. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0, rendered).

multhi.description: Maximum ornament-duration multiplier (>= multlo; same enforced range, 200 refused verbatim). The multlo-multhi spread randomises ornament pacing per statement. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

atten.description: Overall attenuation multiplier, CDP-enforced 0.000002-1 ('Parameter[17] Value (1.500000) out of range (0.000002 to 1.000000)'; -a0.5 verified halving RMS). Breakpoint accepted. Flag order enforced: -a before -p -s -r.

position.description: Centre of the stereo image 0-1 (family-enforced; banner default 0.5). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

spread.description: Spatial spread of texture events 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

seed.description: Random seed - WORKING (-r5 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical in samples AND frame count; -r5 vs -r9 differ; unseeded runs differ). 0/omission = clock. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 30').

whole.description: Play the whole input per event, ignoring mindur/maxdur (verified: changes render, +0.3 s tail on the probe settings).

samedur.description: Ornament notes all take the duration of the ornamented line note (verified: changes render).

instrvary.description: Ornaments not confined to the ornamented note's instrument - multi-input only (verified byte-identical no-op on this single-input entry).

orntop.description: Ornament the HIGHEST note of line chords (default: first listed). Verified byte-identical no-op on a chord-free line.

ornall.description: Ornament ALL notes of line chords. Verified byte-identical no-op without chords.

examples.description: A rising three-note ornament grafted onto a two-note line, restated every 1.5 s.
examples.expected_use:
First write_data_file('nd_orn.txt', '60
#2
0 1 60 64 0.5
1 1 62 64 0.5
#3
0 1 60 64 0.1
0.08 1 62 64 0.1
0.16 1 64 64 0.1'). Ornament placement (before/after each note) is randomly permuted; rerun with seed 5 for the identical take.

examples.description: Slow arabesques: ornaments stretched 2-4x, crescendo contour, phrase period accelerating via breakpoint skiptime.

known_issues: Duration honesty (set_by outdur): +23% at outdur 5, +9.9% at outdur 8 with a 1.5 s line and small ornaments (0.5 s ping source) - overshoot is about the line span plus the final ornament's tail; duration row pinned at outdur 8, tol 0.2, seed 5.

Notedata needs at least TWO '#N' blocks after the pitch line (line, then ornament(s)); one or zero blocks refuse 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' verbatim. Extra ornament blocks are legal (3-block file verified).

Ornament placement before/after each line note is randomly permuted per note (source texture4.c PM_ORNPOS); preornate/postornate force it (separate curated entries; all three DIFFER at the same seed - byte-proof recorded).

Breakpoint surface: outdur/gpspace/contour/seed refuse (parameters 1/14/17/30 verbatim - same numbering as texture decorated); all other numeric positionals plus -a/-p/-s accept (full per-parameter sweep, exit 0; skiptime additionally verified against both endpoints at seed 5).
Flags ORDER-ENFORCED: -a -p -s -r then switches ('option flag -a out of order on cmdline.' verbatim).
Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO. Working -r seed; -r0/omission = clock.

-i/-h/-e are content-dependent no-ops here (single input, chord-free line; each verified byte-identical) - live with multiple inputs / chordal lines via execute(). Modes 1-4 (harmonic fields) remain execute()-only.
skiptime 0 exited cleanly on this probe (contrast the decorated-family hang) but the hang is content-dependent - never map 0 through.
